title: ticfac-exec-subprocess start accepts --attempt but not --try
description:
The manual executor CLI takes --attempt and not --try, so a hand-started attempt's runner sees TICFAC_TRY=0 rather than the tick's real try count. Nothing keys on it today, which is exactly why it is worth fixing now rather than after something does: the reconciler's own dispatches speak a two-number contract (run-wide attempt, per-tick try) and the manual surface speaks half of it.

discovered_from run-epic-9pd/tick-vw0/attempt-30
acceptance_criteria: ticfac-exec-subprocess start accepts --try alongside --attempt and passes it through to the runner's environment, and a test covers a hand-started attempt seeing the try it was given.
